name: getagentictools
description: Search 41,000+ agent skills, MCP servers, plugins & loops — real install counts and stars.
long_description:
Search the full getagentictools.com catalog from Claude: agent skills (SKILL.md), MCP servers, Claude Code plugins, and agentic loops — with **real install counts and GitHub stars**, harvested weekly from GitHub and public registries.

Ask things like *"find me an MCP server for Postgres"* or *"what skills exist for PDF extraction?"* — every result carries its install command and a link to its catalog page.

No account, no API key, no telemetry: the extension reads the catalog's public data endpoints and nothing else.

prompts.name: find_tools
prompts.description: Find the best agentic coding tools for a task, with install commands and citable links
prompts.text: Find the best agentic coding tools for this task: ${arguments.task}. Use search_tools with 2-3 query variants, then get_tool on the top candidates. Recommend at most 3, each with its install command and its getagentictools.com URL.
